binding.text: TIME's Kid of the Year Is Helping First Responders Comfort Children in Crisis
TIME's Kid of the Year Is Helping First Responders Comfort Children in Crisis
Inspired by his own experiences with autism, 9-year-old Ledger Mann created emergency comfort kits for children in crisis. His idea has now spread to six states.
